description: Stored Ask sessions replayed over the same evidence (AGT-02), on live captures: the same L7 build as workspace.object_view (scripts.ontology_projection_probe --build-only over the runner session's shared mirror and projection: a GET-only Portal sync, one GET-only BC capture pass and one bounded Graph-delta capture of the allowlisted purchase-order@ mailbox), then, offline and with no client, scripts.object_workspace_probe --session-replay: the served runtime's case store is moved to the check's own {tmp} (the shared served state is never written), one case is opened for the served host's capture principal with a case-only audience principal, and the console's Ask (operator_ui.object_workspace.ObjectWorkspace.ask with that case_id: the agent loop over the reader's HostAccess.agent_server, the MCP host path every Ask uses) runs on sampled roots (the views' sample order) until 3 sessions are kept, each one hash-chained case event. The planner is deterministic, no model (read the root with plx.object, cite up to three records its card returned): the check measures keeping and replaying evidence, not a model's reasoning, and replay never re-runs a planner. Over the unchanged store each kept session is listed through the workspace's case path (/api/object-case) and replayed through the recorder's workspace (/api/object-replay: the session's read-only calls run again, each call's evidence and each cited digest compared). Pass = at least one session kept, every one replays identically (zero divergence), the recorder sees each, a reader holding only the case's audience principal (in the case, granted no record) sees each as the withheld marker, gets no replay and opens no agent session, no recorded object id or cited handle reaches that reader, and a reader outside the case's audience gets not found. Counts and booleans only; never a question, value, identifier or citation. Also DOC-08: over the check's own temporary case dir a case original is attached through plx.case_attach_original and re-extracted with a citation and a reason (OCR setting changed so the extraction differs); it must yield exactly one new immutable version while every earlier citation still resolves to its original bytes (reextraction.changed_earlier 0, bytes_changed 0). And ING-08: a second GET-only Portal mirror sync over the same since watermark (smallest unique-key relations) re-reads the overlap and adds 0 duplicate rows by the mirror's own capture counts (resync.duplicate_rows 0, not_incremental 0); resync.status reports not_run/not_exercised rather than pass when no Portal or no watermarked relation exists. bc.capture_incremental stays with identity-spine-lot.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no live-check result yet. Module test: injected-transport (tests/test_object_workspace_http.py SessionReplayLiveCheckTest runs this spec's own argv over the fixture world with the Portal, BC and Graph transports injected and checks the printed summary with live_verify.check_expectations; a cited row changed between record and replay there is reported as a divergence and fails the check). The fixture-tier tests of the same path: tests/test_session_replay.py (isolated-fixture: a changed cited row is a citation_content_changed divergence; a reader who lost the cited grant, or whom the console withholds a cited record from, gets the withheld marker and no replay) and tests/test_object_workspace_http.py (the routes). Shares the session's mirror and projection with workspace.object_view (same paths, same audience); its own writes go only to {tmp}/cases. With PLX_WORKBENCH_STATE_DIR set, a new runner session adopts the mirror and projection the warm store kept from one earlier session (verify/live_verify.py SessionState.plan warm: same audience, under 26 h, written coherently) instead of re-running mirror.full_coverage and ontology.session_projection for it (tests/test_session_replay_warm.py, injected-transport: the adopted generation equals a cold build of the same captures). Timing (forecast, unmeasured): the build as workspace.object_view's, then at most 3 Asks of two planner turns and one tool call each, 3 replays and the two other readers' listings inside --view-budget-seconds 600. Rows proved here: DOC-08 by session_replay.reextraction, ING-08 by session_replay.resync; both injected-transport only, live-unverified.
